resourcePresets.body: Electrocharge 26 FP is the normal offensive Body Buff. Golden Lightning Fortification 30 FP or Boiled Crab x5 are safety alternatives. Bloodsucking Physick is an additional learned-fight HP-risk state, so do not compound risk casually.
resourcePresets.regen: Starlight Shard x5 remains emergency-only and excluded from the seven-bar arithmetic. Warming Stone x5 is downtime recovery after Bloodsucking or route attrition.
resourcePresets.weaponBuff: The active Lightning Godskin Stitcher cannot receive Electrify Armament. The Keen Guardian's Swordspear menu state alone may receive Electrify Armament for 27 FP; it may also remain unbuffed for high-lightning-resistance physical fallback.
resourcePresets.variant: Normal stamina pacing is supported by the weapon's thrust rhythm. Do not overwrite the chosen Body Buff with a stamina consumable during the accepted damage state.
resourcePresets.fieldEffect: Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear + Bloodsucking Cracked Tear; Godrick's Great Rune optional. DLC200-INC-OPT raw one-each audit = 284 FP. Lightning Slash costs 10 FP; practical conversion proof = Lightning Slash 10 + Knight's Lightning Spear 29 = 39 FP.
resourcePresets.consumables: Lightning Pot x6; Ancient Dragonbolt Pot x6; Red Lightning Pot x6; Hefty Lightning Pot x4; Hefty Red Lightning Pot x4; Preserving Boluses x10; Thawfrost Boluses x10; Clarifying Boluses x10; Boiled Crab x5; Lightningproof Dried Liver x5; Warming Stone x5; Starlight Shard x5 (preserve).
resourcePresets.useOrder: Choose offensive OR defensive Body Buff → Golden Vow only when efficient → drink Lightning/Bloodsucking only on a learned fight or keep a safer encounter tear swap later → Stitcher running thrusts/charged heavies → Lightning Slash on true melee recovery → Knight's Spear or close red lightning on earned windows → Keen Swordspear hard swap if split lightning underperforms → immediate melee return → heal before greed → Cerulean near empty.
resourcePresets.conflict: Maintain Fulgurbloom 60; Mushroom 50; Gravel Stone 30; Red Fulgurbloom 30; Yellow Fulgurbloom 30; Redflesh Mushroom 40; Boiled Crab 20; cures 20 each; Starlight preserve floor 5. Premium Hefty/Red pot materials are held for high-value no-FP punish windows.

resourcePresets.target: Fashion — Red Lightning Ascendant Display Reserve
resourcePresets.aura: Choose exactly one Aura Buff: Golden Vow 47 FP for general offense/defense OR Dragonbolt of Florissax 35 FP for the red-lightning support identity. Never budget both as a simultaneous baseline.
resourcePresets.body: Choose exactly one Body Buff: Electrocharge 26 FP for aggressive proximity damage OR Dragonbolt Blessing 20 FP for deflection/status resistance; Boiled Crab or Lightningproof Dried Liver are safety alternatives. One Body Buff only.
resourcePresets.regen: Starlight Shard x5 is preserve-by-default emergency FP and excluded from reserve arithmetic. Warming Stone x5 is downtime support.
resourcePresets.weaponBuff: Lightning Milady and Lightning Backhand Blade cannot receive Electrify Armament. No weapon-buff reserve is authorized in the Fashion state.
resourcePresets.variant: Greenburst Physick supports the mobile melee loop. No additional stamina Body Buff is assumed if it would replace Electrocharge/Dragonbolt Blessing/safety.
resourcePresets.fieldEffect: Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear + Greenburst Crystal Tear; Godrick's Great Rune optional. DLC200-INC-FAS raw one-each audit = 287 FP. Wing Stance heavy costs 10 FP; dramatic conversion proof = Wing heavy 10 + accepted Fortissax 35 = 45 FP.

buffs.recommendation: VW-200 Signature pursuit and punish skill.
buffs.conflicts: Requires the unique colossal weapon and a real opening; long commitment can be punished.
buffs.stacksWith: Stonebarb, Shard of Alexander, Spear Talisman and standard buffs.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; do not force the follow-up.

buffs.effect: Drilling multi-hit weapon-skill burst that rapidly activates successive-hit damage and healing effects.
buffs.recommendation: VW-200 Optimized primary burst.
buffs.conflicts: Requires Marais Executioner's Sword and enough target commitment for the drill to connect.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Thorny Tear, Rotten Winged, Godskin and standard buffs.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; Bloodsucking/Rakshasa remains learned-fight risk.

buffs.effect: Aggressive shield rush that applies the Spiked Palisade Shield's bleed pressure while guarding through the charge.
buffs.recommendation: VW-200 Fashion shield state.
buffs.conflicts: Requires the active shield hand; switching to two-handed cleaver removes Shield Crash access.
buffs.stacksWith: Thorny Tear, Shard of Alexander, Lord of Blood's Exultation and standard buffs.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; choose shield state or two-handed Wild Strikes state.

buffs.effect: Restores HP when an enemy is defeated.
buffs.recommendation: VW-200 Signature exploration sustain.
buffs.conflicts: Does not help during isolated boss phases without qualifying adds; occupies one talisman slot.
buffs.stacksWith: Crimsonburst or Bestial Vitality, Body Buffs and normal defenses.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Reusable equipment sustain; not a boss-healing assumption.

buffs.effect: Provides passive HP regeneration while the Icon Shield is actively equipped.
buffs.recommendation: Signature menu hard-swap sustain option.
buffs.conflicts: Requires the shield to remain equipped; cannot coexist with the certified two-handed colossal state.
buffs.stacksWith: Body Buffs, Physick and field healing; formal resource rows still choose one primary regeneration rule.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Reusable hard-swap sustain; excluded from certified active weight.

buffs.effect: Costs 20 FP for one hyperarmor somersault strike; use as a confirmed trade, stagger conversion, or punish rather than a neutral spam loop.
buffs.recommendation: CW-150 Signature primary skill.
buffs.conflicts: Consumes FP and commits through the full attack; grease remains legal because Lion's Claw is not a Weapon Buff.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Two-Handed Sword Talisman, Spiked/Stonebarb, standard Body Buffs, and compatible grease.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; resource preset budgets the base 20-FP cost.

buffs.effect: Costs 22 FP for the shockwave; the heavy follow-up costs no additional FP and supplies the colossal slam.
buffs.recommendation: CW-150 Fashion primary skill.
buffs.conflicts: Slow commitment; the free follow-up is still punishable and requires the Troll weapon state.
buffs.stacksWith: Roar Medallion, Shard of Alexander, Stonebarb, Body Buffs, and the Troll's Hammer moveset.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; do not force the no-FP follow-up when the recovery is unsafe.

buffs.effect: Costs 25 FP, raises attack power, emits a shockwave, and changes Axe of Godfrey strong attacks for the skill duration.
buffs.recommendation: CW-200 Signature defining skill.
buffs.conflicts: Do not recast while the roar state remains active; requires Axe of Godfrey.
buffs.stacksWith: Roar Medallion, Axe Talisman, Spiked Tear, Shard of Alexander, Body Buffs, and heavy attacks.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; one cast should fund an entire intended heavy-attack sequence.

buffs.effect: Costs 16 FP and coats the compatible Heavy weapon in rock, increasing physical and stance pressure.
buffs.recommendation: CW-150 Pickaxe hard swap and CW-200 Counter-Tank Great Mace default.
buffs.conflicts: Mutually exclusive with grease and Royal Knight's Resolve on the same weapon.
buffs.stacksWith: Stonebarb, guard counters, charged attacks, Shard of Alexander where relevant, and normal Body Buffs.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; refresh only when the expected combat duration justifies the cast.

buffs.effect: Enhances precisely timed spontaneous guards and the resulting guard-counter system for the Physick duration.
buffs.recommendation: CW-200 Optimized Counter-Tank default.
buffs.conflicts: Uses one Physick slot and does not eliminate stamina, timing, chip, or guard-break risk.
buffs.stacksWith: Opaline, Curved Sword Talisman, Greatshield Talisman, Verdigris Greatshield, Cragblade, and Body Buffs.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Reusable one-use resource per rest; normal blocking remains valid when timing is uncertain.

buffs.effect: Costs 15 FP and reinforces the held shield against non-physical damage and status effects.
buffs.recommendation: CW-200 Optimized exact exception only.
buffs.conflicts: Mutually exclusive with Shield Grease and other shield-buff effects; requires INT 19 / FAI 19 and the shield held in the opposite hand.
buffs.stacksWith: Cragblade on the weapon, Deflecting/Opaline Physick, Body Buffs, guard counters, and normal defenses.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; does not authorize an offensive Golden Order spell package.

buffs.effect: Costs 13 FP for the first bolt and 13 FP for each chained follow-up; use as precise ranged equipment pressure.
buffs.recommendation: CW-200 Fashion supplemental siege skill.
buffs.conflicts: Repeated follow-ups drain FP rapidly and may not replace Fallingstar Beast Jaw melee as the default rotation.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Spear Talisman where the melee attack qualifies, Opaline/Spiked, and standard Body Buffs.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; formal resource math budgets single 13-FP activations conservatively.

buffs.effect: Costs 7 FP to begin and 7 FP for each continued charge interval; the long fire charge controls crowds and large targets.
buffs.recommendation: CW-200 Fashion Crozier hard-swap skill.
buffs.conflicts: Long commitment and continuing FP drain; stop the channel rather than trade through an unsafe recovery.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Flame, Grant Me Strength, Well-Pickled Turtle Neck, Opaline, and compatible Heavy-Crozier grease when legal.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; resource record states the initial and continuing costs separately.

buffs.effect: Costs 16 FP and may be charged for a larger Crucible vortex slam and stronger stance pressure.
buffs.recommendation: CW-200 Signature menu hard swap.
buffs.conflicts: Requires Devonia's Hammer and a secured commitment window; it does not transfer the loadout to the Ancestral Holy Warrior system.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Godfrey Icon when charged, Stonebarb, Body Buffs, and normal defenses.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; reserve for stagger, long recovery, or spectacle windows.

buffs.effect: Adds matchup damage to a compatible physical-affinity armament without requiring additional permanent stats.
buffs.recommendation: CW-150 Signature Heavy Greatsword; optional Heavy Crozier hard swap at CW-200 Fashion.
buffs.conflicts: Mutually exclusive with Cragblade, Royal Knight's Resolve, and other Weapon Buffs; unique weapons and non-compatible affinities reject it.
buffs.stacksWith: Lion's Claw, charged/jump attacks, Physick, talismans, Body Buffs, and normal defenses when the weapon remains compatible.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Craftable/finite by material supply; use common greases freely and preserve rare drawstring variants for meaningful encounters.

buffs.effect: Costs 26 FP to form a magic greatsword and deliver a chargeable vertical strike.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-150 Signature defining skill.
buffs.conflicts: Requires Carian Knight's Sword; long charge is punishable and the fixed weapon cannot receive Scholar's Armament.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Magic-Shrouding, Godfrey Icon where equipped, phalanx setup, Body defenses, and normal melee.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; use only on a stagger, long recovery, or secured punish.

buffs.effect: Costs 9 FP for a fast guard-piercing thrust and strong stance pressure.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-150 Optimized and CSB-200 Fashion primary thrust skill.
buffs.conflicts: Requires the active weapon state; repeated neutral use can replace the intended melee-sorcery transition loop.
buffs.stacksWith: Spear Talisman, Stonebarb or Deflecting Physick, Scholar enchantments where legal, and delayed blades.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; low cost does not authorize skill spam.

buffs.effect: Costs 16 FP for a longer guard-piercing thrust with full block bypass.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-150 Fashion academy-duelist punish.
buffs.conflicts: Requires Keen Rogier's Rapier and a real spacing or recovery window; slower than Impaling Thrust.
buffs.stacksWith: Spear Talisman, Scholar's Armament, Thorny Physick, delayed glintblades, and standard Body defenses.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; reserve for a justified counterthrust or guard punish.

buffs.effect: Costs 30 FP for the initial magic greatsword strike and 12 FP for the optional horizontal follow-up; either attack can be charged.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-200 Signature defining stance punish.
buffs.conflicts: Magic Milady is not enchantable; the second input is a separate commitment and should not be forced.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Godfrey Icon, Magic-Shrouding, Stonebarb, delayed blades, and standard Body defenses.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; budget the full 42-FP sequence only when both openings are real.

buffs.effect: Costs 15 FP for the light follow-up or 20 FP for the heavy follow-up after the stance input.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-200 Optimized precision punish.
buffs.conflicts: Requires Moonveil; repeated use cannot replace katana melee or staff casting in the parent loop.
buffs.stacksWith: Shard of Alexander, Rellana's Cameo, Magic-Shrouding, Stonebarb, phalanx setup, and normal defenses.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; choose the follow-up matching the opening and avoid neutral spam.

buffs.effect: Costs 25 FP and enchants a compatible physical-affinity weapon with magic damage.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-150 Optimized Keen Milady and CSB-150 Fashion Keen Rogier's Rapier only.
buffs.conflicts: Mutually exclusive with grease and other weapon buffs; fixed, Magic, Cold, Moonveil, Carian Knight's Sword, and Carian Sorcery Sword states reject it.
buffs.stacksWith: Scholar's Shield on a different object, Magic-Shrouding, delayed blades, Body defenses, and melee talismans.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; refresh only when the expected combat duration justifies the cast.

buffs.effect: Costs 30 FP and reinforces the held shield's guarded damage negation.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-150 Signature/Optimized and CSB-200 Fashion shield states.
buffs.conflicts: Mutually exclusive with Shield Grease and other shield buffs; the shield must be held in the opposite hand from the catalyst.
buffs.stacksWith: Scholar's Armament on a separate Keen weapon, Deflecting/Opaline Physick, guard counters, delayed blades, and Body defenses.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; cast only when the shield state will remain relevant.

buffs.effect: Costs 8 FP only when a spell projectile is successfully converted into retaliatory glintblades; physical parries cost no FP.
buffs.recommendation: CSB-150 Signature Carian Knight's Shield menu swap.
buffs.conflicts: Requires the shield-skill state. The generated blades and active phalanx/retaliation sorceries may replace one another.
buffs.stacksWith: Magic-Shrouding, shield play, melee criticals, Body defenses, and normal equipment passives.
buffs.resourcePolicy: Renewable FP; budget only successful spell conversions, not ordinary physical parries.
